description: Uppsala University publishes CAMELS-SE through the Swedish National Data Service. It combines daily precipitation, temperature and streamflow for 50 Swedish catchments from 1961 to 2020, with catchment boundaries, land cover, soil classes, hydrological signatures and regulation information. The repository lists separate ZIP packages for catchment properties, time series and GIS shapefiles, plus documentation. Data are openly accessible and free under CC-BY-4.0. The compiled observations come from Swedish public agencies and Copernicus products. Catchments span 2 to 8,425 square kilometres; ten extend substantially into Norway. The collection supports calibration of runoff models and comparison of water-supply or flood-management simulations between climate periods. A limitation is that a selected catchment sample cannot represent every urban or strongly regulated basin. Users must check source harmonisation and the distinction between observation periods and compilation dates. CAMELS-SE complements other regional CAMELS collections with Nordic catchments, while consistent variable names alone do not establish cross-country comparability.
